meta.title: Vendor reduces the Sum Total by a percentage
gaps: The catalog cannot reliably identify and assert the cost-breakdown discount field and its percentage calculation oracle: current bid must equal Sum Total less the entered percentage.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The catalog cannot reliably identify and assert the cost-breakdown discount field and its percentage calculation oracle: current bid must equal Sum Total less the entered percentage.

steps.note: Open a fitting existing live auction with bidding available, since the case names no event.

Open the auction's vendor pricing sheet.

Attempt to enter the requested 10% discount; the field label is not confirmed by the catalog.
